legacy_operations.description: Non-exact operations that still accept undeclared options and are therefore exempt from the hostile-option matrix. Every entry is reviewed debt.

help.description: Arguments appended to the executable and the command words to print the options of a command (git: ["-h"]). Required with tested_versions.

unlisted_options.description: Declared options, per operation id, that exist in the CLI but are not printed by its help output.

unreachable_operations.description: Operations no argv can reach because an earlier operation always matches first. Reviewed debt: the check fails once such an operation becomes reachable.
